p: Commercial Street is Batley's main shopping street, lined with grand old Victorian buildings that tell the story of the town's wealth from the wool trade. Admiral is an 18+ venue, strictly adults.

The Bagshaw Museum, in a Victorian gothic mansion in Wilton Park, has an eclectic collection that's well worth an hour. Oakwell Hall, a 16th-century manor house with links to Charlotte Brontë's Shirley, is just up the road in Birstall. Batley was also home to the famous Batley Variety Club, where stars like Shirley Bassey and Louis Armstrong performed back in the day.
